evidence_plan.requirement: Comparison with traditional machine learning models
Effect of transfer learning on performance

payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about the performance results of DNN models, comparisons with traditional models, and the effects of transfer learning.

claims.text: DNN models showed significantly improved performance after oversampling bullying posts, with major improvements in evaluation measures.
Traditional machine learning models performed significantly lower than DNN models in cyberbullying detection.
Transfer learning improved recall and precision in cyberbullying detection across datasets, with learned word embeddings being crucial for performance.
Evaluation of models was conducted using five-fold cross-validation to ensure reliability of performance results.
